We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.

The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack.

As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team

What we are looking for in you

description:
Overview

Host Broadcast Production Manager role at FIFA Women's World Cup™

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key responsibilities
  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • Collaborating with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay, including legacy infrastructure at the venues (camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, studios and presentation positions, interview areas, broadcast commentary positions, and all installations within the Broadcast Compound).
  • Supervising, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Working closely with overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly, and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones to be the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, and the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro, coordinating with Media Partners and Relations and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervising, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Serving as main point of contact for Project Lead and Host Broadcaster, providing liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, and issue resolutions.
  • Pre-planning, on-site support and delivery for the Play-off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such events including internal workshops and training sessions.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities
  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions
  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.
Qualifications Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.

  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools

  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French

You will design and implement tailored solutions, integrate Tidio with other tools, and guide clients through adoption and post‑implementation care. Working cross‑functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams, you will ensure smooth adoption, solve real challenges, and make a tangible impact on client success.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and takes ownership of projects that directly impact client success and Tidio’s growth.

  • Set up and configure client accounts, ensuring a smooth start to their Tidio experience.
  • Implement and customize solutions based on each client’s specific business needs.
  • Discuss and design custom solutions with clients and prospective clients during video calls, providing expert guidance and technical insights.

  • Integrate Tidio with external systems (e.g., CRMs, e‑commerce platforms) using APIs and JSON data structures.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, collaborating with Product and Engineering teams when needed.
  • Manage implementation projects from start to finish—planning, coordinating, and ensuring timely delivery.
  • Work cross‑functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to align solutions with client goals.
  • Identify and drive process improvements, helping to streamline and scale the implementation workflow.
You are the perfect fit if you have:
  • Can work from 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST, with availability for video calls with US‑based clients between 4:00 PM–7:00 PM EST.
  • Have a background in Implementation, Technical Onboarding, or Services, ideally in a SaaS environment.
  • Are fluent in English (C1 level) and can clearly explain technical details to non‑technical users.
  • Have experience working directly with clients via written communication and video calls.
  • Understand APIs and JSON structures and can analyze or test requests.
  • Have solid knowledge of CX platforms such as Tidio, Zendesk, HubSpot, or Salesforce.
  • Can evaluate technical requirements and design solutions that meet real client needs.
  • Have experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve integration or feature gaps.
  • Proactively solve problems, bring creative ideas, and consistently deliver results.
  • Have basic coding experience, e.g., JavaScript or Python (nice to have).
We would like to offer you:
  • A chance to work with one of the top AI products in the customer experience industry.
  • Hands‑on growth and technical mastery—deepen your technical and soft skills by implementing solutions that are often critical for clients’ business success.
  • Ownership and cross‑functional impact—lead end‑to‑end complex projects, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, and make a direct impact on both client success and Tidio’s growth.
  • Work with a team that continually shares knowledge and is not afraid of testing new solutions.
  • Remote work model with flexible hours.
  • Possibility to work from one of our offices in Szczecin/Warsaw or access to coworking spaces in your city.
  • 26 days off guaranteed in a year.
  • Great development opportunities—company‑supported courses and conferences.
  • Individual work tools—MacBook Pro, Dell screen, JBL headphones (you can tailor the equipment to your needs).
  • Sport & wellness benefit (or its equivalent).
  • Private medical care.
  • Mental well‑being program—individual therapy sessions and resources for employees.
  • Free access to one of the most popular e‑book/audiobook services.
  • Regular social events (company‑wide offsites, team events).
  • Budget for 1:1 English language classes.

  • Offer and fireworks

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar e interpretar exames, diagnosticar e tratar doenças, através da visualização de ossos, órgãos ou estruturas através exames radiológicos e de imagens em geral, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas: Criar alerta

Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.

Vaga destinada para atuar em projeto de cliente SONDA.

Modalidade de Trabalho: CLT

Endereço: Imboassica - Macaé/RJ

Horário: 08h às 17h (seg à sex).

Nesta função você irá:

Desenvolver e implantar soluções sistêmicas e ferramentas para otimização e automatização de processos, dimensionar requisitos e funcionalidades dos sistemas, escolher ferramentas de desenvolvimento, administrar ambientes informatizados, elaborar documentação técnica, assessorar na coordenação de projetos, oferecer soluções para ambientes informatizados, pesquisar tecnologias e soluções, analisar e processar dados, planejar atividades de pesquisas, estudando o cenário da organização e suas regras de negócio, desenvolver metodologias de análise de dados, criar, validar e documentar modelos estatísticos, matemáticos e/ou computacionais, criar banco de dados, construir instrumentos de coleta e desenvolver sistemas de codificação de dados; comunicar-se, interpretando e reportando resultados das análises de dados.

Necessário para oportunidade:

  • Ensino superior concluído em Sistemas da Informação ou Ciência da Computação
  • Experiência comprovada como Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas/Desenvolvedor

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, mental e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabemos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Overview

Um time que faz parte da mudança. Abraçamos o poder da mudança para criar valor e sucesso compartilhado para nossos clientes, funcionários, acionistas, parceiros e comunidades. Contamos com a maior rede mundial de centros de tecnologia avançada e operações inteligentes. Provocamos a mudança no mercado. Trabalhamos juntos mundo afora para fazer um mundo de diferenças. Na Accenture, investimos no desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais como nenhuma outra organização. Profissionais com oportunidades iguais para se desenvolver. Incentivamos a progressão de carreira por mérito, tendo como base o nosso principal valor: Respeito ao Indivíduo. Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end (G1, Globo.com, Gshow, Globoplay, GE, Cartola)

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Trabalhamos com uma variedade de tecnologias e linguagens para atingir nossos objetivos, além de estabelecermos uma relação contínua e crescente de compartilhamento de soluções com a comunidade de tecnologia.

A inscrição em nosso banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da disponibilidade de vagas e avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Procurar sempre criar para os produtos Globo a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de perto com os especialistas em UX;

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Ter habilidades em algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de software, como princípios, boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura; Experiência com desenvolvimento de Aplicações Escaláveis;
  • Vivência com algumas linguagens de programação como: Python, Golang, Java, Ruby, Elixir, Scala, Clojure, C/C++, C#, JavaScript, etc.;
  • Prática com as ferramentas de versionamento (como GIT, SVN, etc.);
  • Experiência em escrever testes;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados MySQL, SQL, MongoDB, Oracle, etc.;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.

    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.

    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.

    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.

  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Context & Environment

Subsidiária recém-produtora com fases de exploração, avaliação e desenvolvimento em ativos operados. Os projetos estão predominantemente em LAPA (produção, projetos e perfuração de avaliação) e C-M-541 (perfuração exploratória com potencial para avançar para perfuração de avaliação).

  • Ambiente de alto custo com regulamentações locais rigorosas.
  • Contexto de águas profundas / ultra-profundas.
  • Poços exploratórios (ambiente sensível e remoto).
  • Assunção de uma instalação existente operada por terceiros.
  • Assistência contratual a ativos operados por terceiros (OBO – Operated by Others).
  • Alto nível de riscos técnicos devido aos custos operacionais.
  • Alto nível de objetivos de desempenho.
  • Trabalho em equipe dentro de uma estrutura enxuta.
  • Relacionamento com autoridades estaduais/reguladores, se aplicável.

O titular do cargo atua em um ambiente multidisciplinar de contratos e compras (exploração, perfuração, desenvolvimento, trabalho no mar e em terra) em um ambiente internacional e ambiente de conteúdo local simultaneamente.

A falta ou entrega tardia de materiais ou serviços, independentemente de seu valor, pode ter consequências importantes na produção e nas finanças.

Atividades

O(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da Empresa, bem como sua reputação.

As principais atividades do titular do cargo são:

  • Supervisionar o estabelecimento dos contratos, participando diretamente dos contratos e pedidos de compra mais complexos.
  • Validar ou garantir a validação de todos os documentos contratuais e cartas formais emitidas pela área de contratos e compras.
  • Participar de auditorias contratuais seletivas para garantir o cumprimento dos termos e condições contratuais.
  • Intervir na resolução de litígios, em conjunto com as áreas Jurídica, Seguros e Financeira, propondo estratégias e ações, e participando das negociações.
  • Definir e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para garantir a melhoria da eficiência.
  • Manter atualizados os conteúdos locais dos modelos de contrato (condições gerais e particulares), e adaptar versões internacionais às exigências locais.
  • Garantir o reporte global da equipe de Contratos e Compras à gestão da SCLC.
  • Definir, adotar e monitorar estratégias de contratação e compras adequadas (por categorias, etc.).
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, sendo responsável por garantir o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas e boas práticas, não apenas com a SCLC, mas também com outras áreas da Empresa.
  • Realizar todas as atividades de contratação em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empresa e com a legislação brasileira.
  • Definir a estratégia de contratação em conjunto com o(a) contraparte do “Dueto” para atender e proteger os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa.
  • Propor, pré-qualificar e recomendar contratantes/fornecedores adequados para listas de licitação, visando maximizar a eficiência dos processos de concorrência.
  • Compilar, emitir e administrar pacotes de “Convite para Licitação” para obter propostas realistas e comercialmente atrativas de potenciais contratantes/fornecedores. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).
  • Redigir termos e condições contratuais e comerciais apropriados para melhor atender e proteger os interesses da Empresa.
  • Revisar propostas, participar de esclarecimentos e negociações contratuais e comerciais, preparar todos os documentos associados, como apresentações, atas de reuniões, registro de qualificações contratuais e comerciais, minuta de recomendação de adjudicação, finalizar o contrato, administrar a adjudicação de contratos, ordens de mudança/variação, aditivos contratuais, reivindicações e toda a correspondência associada.
  • Revisar e considerar os aspectos legais associados à adjudicação e administração de contratos, em articulação com o Departamento Jurídico, fornecendo aconselhamento aos clientes conforme apropriado e auxiliando, quando necessário, na resolução de litígios.
  • Arquivar a documentação contratual e correspondências de forma lógica, organizada e auditável.
  • Participar da aprovação externa (Parceiros), revisando os boletins com as informações relevantes de C&P.
  • Garantir que todos os certificados contratuais, garantias, cauções e seguros exigidos no portfólio de contratos estejam em vigor dentro do prazo.
  • Facilitar reuniões necessárias para a condução das atividades do cargo.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Ativos Operados por Terceiros (OBO), participando de apresentações do Operador e assessorando nos aspectos contratuais e comerciais.

O titular do cargo gerencia a Conformidade:

  • Verificar que as Políticas de Contratos e Compras da empresa e as leis e regulamentos aplicáveis estão sendo seguidos, especialmente no que diz respeito à ética e transparência.
  • Verificar que os documentos e procedimentos de compras estão em conformidade com os padrões da empresa e com os acordos firmados com os parceiros.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o respeito aos procedimentos durante o processo de licitação.
  • Assegurar a aplicação das Condições Gerais de Compra da TEPBR, especialmente no que diz respeito a equipamentos complexos, de alto valor e alto risco.

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Servir como exemplo pessoal na adesão aos procedimentos de HSE da TEPBR.
  • Promover conscientização e fornecer orientação aos colaboradores sob sua supervisão quanto à execução das regras de HSE, tanto para funcionários da Empresa quanto para fornecedores, sem prejudicar as obrigações legais do Contratado.
  • Assegurar, para si e para os colaboradores sob sua supervisão, a segurança do ambiente de trabalho, evitando riscos às pessoas, às instalações e impactos ao meio ambiente.
  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares e reportar quaisquer incidentes (anomalias, atos inseguros, quase acidentes, danos, derramamentos, lesões, etc.).
  • Notificar os colaboradores relevantes sobre acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes, e iniciar ações corretivas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar, negociar, adjudicar e administrar contratos/pedidos de compra de obras, bens e serviços de forma a garantir que os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa sejam atendidos e protegidos.
  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.
  • Os indicadores e KPIs sejam observados, monitorados e devidamente reportados.
  • Os objetivos de desempenho e eficiência de custos em Contratos e Compras sejam cumpridos.
  • O conhecimento técnico em Contratos e Compras seja compartilhado dentro do grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
Perfil do Candidato

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

Qualificação e Experiência:

  • Formação superior (nível universitário ou acima).
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos processos de compras, incluindo: princípios éticos; pré-qualificação de licitantes; convite para licitação; avaliação comparativa de contratantes; adjudicação, gestão de reivindicações, administração, alteração e encerramento de contratos.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.
  • Conhecimento geral e compreensão das funções empresariais da empresa, com entendimento aprofundado da função de contratos e de como ela agrega valor, além de compromisso em entregar valor agregado.
  • Deve ter proficiência em inglês e fluência em português.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.

LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Planejar e organizar a rotina da cozinha, incluindo horários de produção e operação. Monitorar o tempo de produção e garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos.

  • Manutenção de Equipamentos: monitorar o uso adequado dos equipamentos de cozinha e solicitar manutenções ou substituições quando necessário. Garantir a correta limpeza e conservação dos utensílios e maquinários.

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.

Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operation Center
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Previous professional experience working or leading a Security Operation Center
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO27001

Optional things we value

  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.

Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP.

The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. People sometimes use it as a build farm on a shared server, for example.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar quantitative discipline)
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as API, ASME, and OSHA.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.

Gestão Operacional:
Supervisionar a preparação e o serviço de alimentos, garantindo o cumprimento de padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Planejar e organizar a rotina da cozinha, incluindo horários de produção e operação.
Monitorar o tempo de produção e garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos.

Liderança de Equipe:
Liderar e treinar a equipe de cozinheiros, distribuindo tarefas e monitorando a performance. Coordenar escalas de trabalho, garantindo que a equipe esteja adequada às demandas do serviço. Resolver conflitos e promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.

Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar em todas as etapas da produção.

Gerenciar o custo dos alimentos, mantendo a operação dentro do orçamento estabelecido. Analisar relatórios de custos e desperdícios, sugerindo melhorias para otimização de recursos.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
  • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
  • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
  • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
  • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Direct message the job poster from InPlanet

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Hybrid Remote: ideally around Sao Paulo
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial emInspeção, Verificação, Testes eCertificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando adiscriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Você atuará na montagem e soldagem de peças e estruturas , interpretando desenhos técnicos e aplicando seus conhecimentos de relações geométricas.

Sobre a empresa

Nosso cliente é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas empresas de metalurgia do Brasil . Com mais de 30 anos de experiência, atua nas áreas de caldeiraria, serralheria industrial, ferramentaria e desenvolvimento de projetos para movimentação e armazenagem de materiais, localizada na Baixada Fluminense.

Responsabilidades

  • Montagem e soldagem de peças utilizando dispositivos de solda;
